thesis: Beauty has real value alongside truth, freedom and livability; sacrifices require asking who chose them and who bears them.

ideas.statement: Shared pleasure and positional rewards differ; criticism should reveal costs without denying pleasure or inventing universal reconciliation.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: The four imagined choices preserve real conflicts: accurate communication may lose impact, public composition may impair use, equalized attraction may violate consent, artistic risk may burden others.
